context: You are training to work as a guide at the university's history museum. Listen to the museum director and repeat what she says.
visual: A museum gallery with glass cases of ancient pottery and coins and an old map on the wall.
sentences: Most of the pottery is very fragile.
These coins were discovered near the river last year.
Each display case is kept at a constant temperature and humidity.
The map on the wall shows the trade routes used by early merchants.
Archaeology students from our university helped to clean and catalogue many of the items you see here.
If visitors want more information about a particular object, they can scan the code printed on the label beside it.

context: You have a new job helping at the university's student health center. Listen to the clinic administrator and repeat what he says.
visual: A clean waiting room with chairs, a reception window, health posters on the wall and a hand sanitizer station.
sentences: The nurse will call your name soon.
Appointments can be made online or by phone.
Students must bring their health insurance card to every visit.
Flu vaccinations are offered free of charge during October and November.
Anyone who arrives without an appointment may have to wait for up to an hour on busy days.
For emergencies that happen outside our opening hours, students should go directly to the city hospital on Park Road.
